∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Optimized) (hxs : List.range' 1 p.m ≠ []),
  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p =
      List.minOn (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.batchObjective p) (List.range' 1 p.m) hxs →
    ∀ i < p.m,
      outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p = 1 + i →
        ¬(1 ≤ outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p ∧
              outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.optimizedBatch p < 1 + p.m) →
          False
